mapper.select: SELECT rh.recommend_id AS recommendId, p.product_id AS productId, p.category_id AS categoryId, p.name, p.price, p.discount_price AS discountPrice, p.image_url AS imageUrl, rh.score, rh.reason FROM recommendation_history rh JOIN products p ON p.product_id = rh.product_id WHERE rh.user_id = #{userId} AND rh.created_at::date = CURRENT_DATE AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' AND p.stock > 0 ORDER BY rh.score DESC, rh.recommend_id

WITH valid_purchase AS ( SELECT DISTINCT o.user_id, oi.product_id FROM orders o JOIN orders_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.payment_status = 'PAID' AND o.order_status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'RETURNED') ), target_items AS ( SELECT product_id FROM valid_purchase WHERE user_id = #{userId} ), similarity AS ( SELECT candidate.product_id, COUNT(DISTINCT seed.user_id)::double precision AS score FROM target_items target JOIN valid_purchase seed ON seed.product_id = target.product_id JOIN valid_purchase candidate ON candidate.user_id = seed.user_id WHERE candidate.product_id != target.product_id AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM target_items bought WHERE bought.product_id = candidate.product_id ) GROUP BY candidate.product_id ) SELECT p.product_id AS productId, p.category_id AS categoryId, p.name, p.price, p.discount_price AS discountPrice, p.image_url AS imageUrl, s.score, '구매 패턴이 비슷한 회원들이 함께 선택했어요' AS reason FROM similarity s JOIN products p ON p.product_id = s.product_id WHERE p.status = 'ACTIVE' AND p.stock > 0 ORDER BY s.score DESC, p.product_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.product_id AS productId, p.category_id AS categoryId, p.name, p.price, p.discount_price AS discountPrice, p.image_url AS imageUrl, COALESCE( SUM(oi.quantity) FILTER (WHERE o.order_id IS NOT NULL), 0 )::double precision AS score, '지금 많이 선택하는 인기 상품이에요' AS reason FROM products p LEFT JOIN orders_item oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id AND o.payment_status = 'PAID' AND o.order_status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'RETURNED') WHERE p.status = 'ACTIVE' AND p.stock > 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM orders bought_order JOIN orders_item bought_item ON bought_item.order_id = bought_order.order_id WHERE bought_order.user_id = #{userId} AND bought_order.payment_status = 'PAID' AND bought_order.order_status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'RETURNED') AND bought_item.product_id = p.product_id ) GROUP BY p.product_id, p.category_id, p.name, p.price, p.discount_price, p.image_url ORDER BY score DESC, p.product_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO recommendation_history ( user_id, product_id, reason, score, shown, clicked, converted ) VALUES
( #{userId}, #{item.productId}, #{item.reason}, #{item.score}, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE )
mapper.update: WITH attribution AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (o.order_id, oi.product_id) rh.recommend_id, o.order_id FROM orders o JOIN orders_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN recommendation_history rh ON rh.user_id = o.user_id AND rh.product_id = oi.product_id AND rh.clicked = TRUE AND rh.created_at <= o.ordered_at AND rh.created_at >= o.ordered_at - INTERVAL '7 days' WHERE o.payment_status = 'PAID' AND o.order_status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'RETURNED') ORDER BY o.order_id, oi.product_id, rh.created_at DESC ) UPDATE recommendation_history rh SET converted = TRUE, order_id = attribution.order_id FROM attribution WHERE rh.recommend_id = attribution.recommend_id AND (rh.converted = FALSE OR rh.order_id IS DISTINCT FROM attribution.order_id)
